about: The classic PlayStation®2 rhythm game is back to rock your world!
Rhythm game hero Gitaroo-Man comes to PS4 and PS5 for the very first time!

Go from loser to legend with the mythical Gitaroo, an instrument-turned-weapon that can take down any enemy with the power of music! Press, pitch, and play to the rhythm as the young protagonist U-1 fights his way through enemies and gains confidence in himself along the way. Enjoy the unique and heartwarming atmosphere, rock out to the classic soundtrack, and lose yourself in the iconic, colorful designs created by famed Japanese illustrator 326.

This game software has been ported from the PlayStation®2 version to both PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5. Some content may be different from the PlayStation®2 version, and some functions may not work correctly. This game software does not support peripherals for the PlayStation®2 version, so some additional functions may not be available.
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: The classic PlayStation®2 rhythm game is back to rock your world!
